title: Quick-Fix Mally Irish Pork Roast
description: Malty, juicy, and quickly cooked, this Irish-inspired dish features a flavorful pork shoulder roast, keto-friendly and perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Dust the pork shoulder roast with flour, shaking off excess.
In a large Dutch oven, heat 2 tablespoons of butter over medium-high heat. Sear the pork roast on all sides until browned, about 2-3 minutes per side. Remove the roast from the pot and set aside.
Add the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter to the pot, then add the garlic powder, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the Irish stout beer to the pot, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom. Bring the beer to a simmer and cook until slightly reduced, about 2 minutes.
Return the pork roast to the pot and sprinkle with malted brown sugar. Add the chopped rosemary and thyme on top of the roast.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and roast for 20 minutes per pound, or until the internal temperature reaches 145°F (63°C).
Remove the pot from the oven and let the roast rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing.
If desired, serve with a dollop of heavy cream on top.
